body.title: Let FeedbackInput carry a source
body.summary: Add the optional source { system, externalId, url? } to FeedbackInput in src/workflow/feedback/feedback-service.ts: FeedbackService.add stores it on the entry, validates it (a system and an external id), and compares it when an id is repeated.
acceptanceChecks: An entry added with a source is stored with it and read back with it
The same id with the same fields and the same source appends nothing; the same id with a different source is refused as already used with different content
A source with no system or no external id is refused
An entry added with no source is stored exactly as before

tests.name: feedback-source.test.ts: FeedbackService.add stores a source and a repeat of the same id with the same source appends nothing
